text:
Be the person who makes sure our products actually work for the people who use them.

 Daemon Ventures is a US technology company that builds and runs internet businesses with a very small team and heavy use of AI. We are hiring a full-time QA tester to see our products through our customers' eyes. You will use our live products the way a real customer would, every day, and make sure that nothing broken, confusing or inconsistent goes unnoticed.

 What you'll do
 - Every day, go through our live products as a new customer would: sign up with a real email address, check that the emails arrive, use the core features, pay, cancel and ask for help. Do this on your phone and on a computer.
 - Test new products and significant changes before and after they go live.
 - Report what you find clearly:
 - the steps to reproduce it
 - what you expected
 - what actually happened
 - a screenshot or screen recording
 - how much it matters to a customer
 - Re-test every fix, and mark it done only when it really works.
 - Notice what nobody asked you to check: a price that doesn't match, an email that lands in spam, a page that's confusing on a small screen.
 - Suggest what should be checked automatically, so the same problem is caught immediately next time.

 Who you are
 - Meticulous and persistent. You finish every flow end to end, including the steps after the first screen.
 - A clear writer in English. Anyone can reproduce your report without asking you a question.
 - Reliable. You keep a daily rhythm without being chased, and you report the real state, including "I couldn't finish this, and here's why."
 - Good judgment about what matters. You can tell a bug that loses customers from a cosmetic one.
 - Comfortable working remotely, independently and alongside AI. Much of our building and operations is automated, and your reports go straight into that work.

 Details
 - Full-time and remote, within India. You would be engaged as an independent contractor, paid monthly.
 - Experience: 1–3 years of manual testing of web or mobile products.
 - Helpful: browser developer tools, mobile testing and a bug tracker.
 - Pluses, not requirements: API testing (e.g. Postman), basic SQL, or some exposure to test automation.
 - Pay: ₹6–9 LPA, based on experience.
 - Process:
 1. A short application that includes a practical test (about 30–45 minutes).
 2. A conversation or two.
 3. A first month working together on the real work.

 To apply: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfiuw46fmKgdxHJgrheYJi9R2xDVFvvzQNnnvL2vzJSCUA3_Q/viewform

 The form includes the practical test. Please don't send a CV alone; the test is how we'll get to know you.
